name: Stokro – Simple Stock Management Plugin
author: SoftXpo

sections.description:
Stokro is a minimal and user-friendly plugin that helps you manage your inventory directly from your WordPress dashboard. Whether you run a small shop or a large warehouse, this plugin provides all the essential tools to monitor and control your stock.

Key Features:

  • ✅ Unlimited product management
  • ✅ Stock In & Stock Out tracking
  • ✅ Low stock reporting with thresholds
  • ✅ Profit calculation for each product
  • ✅ Easy-to-use interface
  • ✅ Lightweight and fast performance
  • ✅ No complex setup required

This plugin is ideal for small businesses, e-commerce owners, or anyone needing a straightforward stock control system within WordPress.

License

This plugin is free software licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/stokro directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Stokro in the WordPress admin menu to start managing your products.
sections.faq:
Is there any limit to the number of products I can manage?

No, you can manage unlimited products with this plugin.

Can I calculate profit for each product?

Yes, you can define cost and selling price for products to automatically calculate profit.

Does it support low stock alerts?

Yes, you can set low stock thresholds and generate reports when stock levels are below the set limit.
